entries.name: cls(col)
entries.description: Fill the character screen with col.

entries.name: put(cx, cy, str, col1?, col2?)
entries.description: Persistent cell text; foreground/background: omit/null = PCG.

entries.name: spr(x, y, str, col)
entries.description: 8px-spaced text; newlines, transparent background, one frame; max 128 characters per frame.

entries.name: btn(id)
entries.description: True while the button is held.

entries.name: btnp(id)
entries.description: True on a new press; same IDs as btn.

entries.name: play(ch, str)
entries.description: Play sound on channel 0–2 using ZX 128 PLAY.

entries.name: upix(x, y, col)
entries.description: Draw one pixel at the supplied coordinates.

entries.name: ulin(x1, y1, x2, y2, col)
entries.description: Draw a clipped one-pixel line segment.

entries.name: urec(x, y, w, h, lineCol, fillCol?)
entries.description: Draw a rectangle outline and optionally fill its interior; x,y is the top-left corner.

entries.name: uelp(x, y, w, h, lineCol, fillCol?)
entries.description: Draw an ellipse or circle outline and optionally fill it; equal width and height makes a circle.

entries.name: pcg[chr]
entries.description: 8-byte pattern and foreground/background colors; max 256 modified characters per run, 256 bytes written per frame.

entries.name: scr[cy][cx]
entries.description: Cell character and colors; null inherits PCG colors.

entries.name: BG.spr(x, y, str, col)
entries.description: Draw sprites on the background layer; cleared and redrawn every frame. Also supports upix(), ulin(), urec() and uelp() with the same arguments.

entries.name: MG.spr(x, y, str, col)
entries.description: Draw sprites on the middle layer; rendered after BG and before FG. Also supports upix(), ulin(), urec() and uelp() with the same arguments.

entries.name: FG.spr(x, y, str, col)
entries.description: Draw sprites on the foreground layer; rendered above BG and MG. Also supports upix(), ulin(), urec() and uelp() with the same arguments.

entries.name: tick()
entries.description: Update the game at 60 Hz.

entries.name: ucpl.set(index, r, g, b)
entries.description: Change one palette color; RGB components are integers 0–255. Returns ucpl for chaining.

entries.name: ucpl.setAll(colors)
entries.description: Replace all eight colors with an array of eight [r, g, b] triplets. Validates all entries before applying.

entries.name: ucpl.get(index)
entries.description: Read a color as an independent {r, g, b} object.
entries.example:
const c = ucpl.get(3)
ucpl.set(3, Math.min(255, c.r + 2), c.g, c.b)

entries.name: ucpl.reset()
entries.description: Restore the standard eight-color palette; returns ucpl.

entries.name: urnd()
entries.description: Random floating-point number from 0 (inclusive) to 1 (exclusive).

entries.name: usin(n) · ucos(n) · utan(n)
entries.description: Sine, cosine and tangent. Angles are in radians.

entries.name: usqr(n) · uabs(n)
entries.description: Square root and absolute value.
entries.example: const distance = usqr(dx * dx + dy * dy)

entries.name: uflr(n) · ucei(n)
entries.description: Round down (floor) and round up (ceil).

entries.name: umin(...n) · umax(...n)
entries.description: Smallest and largest of the supplied numbers.

entries.name: upow(base, exponent) · uatan2(y, x)
entries.description: Power and two-argument arctangent; angles are in radians.

entries.name: cdefgab
entries.description: Notes in the current octave.

entries.name: CDEFGAB
entries.description: Notes one octave higher.

entries.name: O0–O8
entries.description: Set octave; O5c is middle C.
Sharp, flat and rest.

sound.title: Lengths

entries.description: Triplets apply to the next three notes.
Tie by adding note lengths together.

sound.description: Write the length before notes: 5ceg = quarter notes. Default: 5.

entries.name: T60–T240
entries.description: Tempo in BPM; set on channel 0.

entries.name: V0–V15
entries.description: Set volume, from silent to loud.

entries.name: U · X0–X65535
entries.description: U: envelope unless V is used. X: period (X0 = X1/2).

entries.name: W0–W7
entries.description: Select a volume envelope shape.

entries.name: M1–M63
entries.description: Tone bits 1/2/4; noise bits 8/16/32.
Repeat twice / loop forever.

entries.name: H
entries.description: Stop all channels at this point.

entries.name: N
entries.description: Separate adjacent numbers.
Ignore text between ! marks.
